item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 29/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Krathon will move across the Luzon Strait and intensify gradually in the next couple of days. Its outer subsiding air will bring very hot weather to southern China. Krathon will then move towards the vicinity of Taiwan to the East China Sea. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong on Tuesday. The weather will be generally fine and dry over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and southern parts of the South China Sea.
